limitations: TypeScript AST discovery extracts literal admin branches and dynamic match subpaths; inventory is discovery, not behavior evidence.
Admin aliases share one handler and therefore inherit its administrator guard, but every expanded operation still requires matched behavioral execution evidence.
IRC and service subcommand inventories are statically discovered and are not behavioral security coverage.
Broad missing-credential route-loop evidence proves authentication-before-resource-access for that exact method/route shape, not successful operation behavior or all ownership dimensions.
DELETE outgoing webhook positive is exact actual returned hook ID plus200; source does not independently assert post-delete list absence.
Additional guest metadata GET proves exact body but has no explicit200 assertion itself; registered-user GET status is separately covered and guest proof is not used as a replacement.
Existing command baseline references retain their own historical scope and may need coordinator matching/review; no command execution count is inferred here.
